user_query: I want to surprise my friend with a smartwatch as a gift. Can you suggest the latest smartwatches available in the market? Also, provide information about the shipping options to my location for these products. Additionally, I would like to know the supply chain information for the companies that manufacture these smartwatches.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest smartwatch models available in the market.
Retrieve shipping options for the selected smartwatches to the user's location.
Gather supply chain information for the manufacturers of the smartwatches.
